title: FC Schalke 04 confirm staff for the 2024/25 season - Fußball
content: # FC Schalke 04 confirm staff for the 2024/25 season. “Over the summer break, we have successfully been able to arrange the new team of staff at the club. Our goal was to recruit a group of employees who entirely embody the vision of Schalke 04 that we have formulated in collaboration with the club’s sporting management and leadership. Mario Grevelhörster, who previously worked as S04’s team manager for three years, will now be responsible for Schalke’s transport management, kit management, and the newly created area of integration management as the administrative head of the first-team setup. Lorenz Kutscha-Lissberg, who is another new addition to the team, will be responsible for overseeing Schalke’s match analysis, and has joined the club after most recently working as Head of Scouting and Analysis at FK Austria Vienna. A number of staff members will no longer be involved with the club ahead of the upcoming campaign, including Jörn Menger, former Head of Performance, who joined S04 from VfL Bochum back in 2021.
